name: K.A. Archer

skills.name: Curved Shot
skills.description: (Basic Attack) Fires a projectile dealing Physical DMG. Ranged 2-3.

skills.name: Defense (AoE)
skills.description: (Reaction) When hit by active AoE, reduces DMG taken.

skills.name: Full Draw
skills.description: (Support) After use, basic attack DMG increases; NRG not recovered at end of turn.

skills.name: Dharana
skills.description: (Passive) At start of turn, if no enemies within 2 tiles, gains a buff for 1 turn.

skills.name: Covering Shot
skills.description: (Support) Performs covering fire against nearby enemies, up to 2 times per round.

summary: Rare archer with covering fire and positioning passive.
